english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something known to you or for being acquainted with a person, subject, or system.
Use this when a person, place, subject, or thing is familiar rather than simply publicly known.

examples.english: I’m very familiar with this system.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 hou2 suk6 sik1

examples.english: I’m very familiar with this place; it’s well known to me.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 suk6 sik1
